about: Get-ChatqIdleSeconds (src/alerts.ps1) on macOS: ioreg -c IOHIDSystem's output, read as PowerShell reads a program's lines; the first line that -match 'HIDIdleTime' (any case, under en-US), and in it the first =\s*(\d+), [double] of the digits / 1e9; null when there is no such line or number, or [double] cannot read the digits. The answer is the double's IEEE-754 bits as 16 hex digits, or null. Rust: idle::idle_seconds
